plugins.name: look-studio
plugins.description: A look studio: design your own animated Claude theme with Claude's help (/look new), preview it live, save, share and switch with /look. Comes with Neon Circuit and Turbine Hall.

plugins.name: neon-circuit
plugins.description: Cyberpunk look: a live circuit-board backdrop in neon purple and green, with hard blue and red.

plugins.name: turbine-hall
plugins.description: Industrial gas-turbine look in red, white and charcoal: turning compressor and turbine rotors, a live blueprint cutaway with airflow and flame, embers and gauges.

description: Animated looks for Claude's desktop and mobile apps, and a studio to make your own.
